question: How can I track my order?
answer: You can track your order from My Account > Orders. Click the order and select 'Track shipment'. A tracking link is also emailed to you as soon as the order ships.

question: How do I cancel my order?
variations: I want to cancel my purchase
answer: Orders can be cancelled free of charge until they are dispatched. Go to My Account > Orders and choose 'Cancel order'. If the order has already shipped, you can refuse delivery or start a return once it arrives.

question: Can I change the delivery address after placing an order?
answer: You can change the delivery address within 2 hours of placing the order from My Account > Orders > Edit address. After that, please contact support with your order number and we'll try to intercept the package.

question: What is your return policy?
variations: how many days do I have to return a product
answer: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if they are unused and in original packaging. Final-sale and personalised items are not eligible.

question: How do I start a return?
variations: return a product step by step
how to send back my purchase
answer: Open My Account > Orders, pick the item and choose 'Return item'. Print the prepaid label (or show the QR code at a drop-off point), pack the item, and hand it to the courier.

question: How long does a refund take?
variations: when will I get my money back
I have not received my refund
how many days for a refund to arrive
answer: Refunds are issued within 3 business days of us receiving your return. Depending on your bank, it can take another 5-7 business days to appear on your statement.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking, popular wallets and cash on delivery (for orders under 10,000 INR).

question: My payment failed but money was deducted. What should I do?
answer: Don't worry - failed transactions are auto-reversed by your bank within 5-7 business days. If the order did not get created and the amount is not returned after 7 days, share the transaction ID with support and we'll investigate.

question: How do I reset my password?
variations: can't log in to my account
answer: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page, enter your registered email and follow the link we send (valid for 30 minutes). Check your spam folder if it doesn't arrive.

question: How can I delete my account?
answer: Go to Settings > Privacy > Delete account. Your data is permanently removed after a 14-day grace period, during which you can restore the account by logging in.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3-7 business days and express delivery takes 1-2 business days in major cities. The exact estimate is shown at checkout.

question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Shipping is free on orders above 499 INR. Below that, a flat fee of 49 INR applies for standard delivery; express delivery is 99 INR.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Yes, we ship to over 40 countries. International delivery typically takes 7-14 business days, and customs duties may apply at the destination.

question: What are your customer support hours?
answer: Our support team is available Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 8 PM IST, via chat, phone (1800-000-000) and email (support@example.com).

question: Do your products come with a warranty?
answer: Electronics carry a 1-year manufacturer warranty and other products a 6-month warranty. To claim, open My Account > Orders > 'Warranty claim' and upload a photo of the issue and your invoice.

question: How do I apply a discount code?
answer: Enter your code in the 'Promo code' box on the cart page and click Apply. Codes can't be combined, and some are limited to specific categories or minimum order values.
